default/30477.htm.text: Sir Ortho Lancer: A pleasure to meet you, I am Ortho Lancer. I was given my title by the lord of this land and am in charge of the security in Giran Castle Town. I will not forgive anyone who disturbs the town s peace, so you must see to your behavior.

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
